supplementalIsolationAudit.guardCorrection: The additional process guard matched its own shell argument text rather than only executable paths. Its metadata assertion failed; the shell proceeded to measure because it lacked set -e. Rechecking the retained actual prestart process table by executable confirms no compiler present. This supplemental metadata replay occurred after timing started; no source/binary/sampling change and no restart. Core qualified preflight had already passed before timing. Retain this limitation explicitly.
